source.label: Third-quarter 2026 results (Form 6-K furnished October 22, 2026), share data table

notes: One series of B Shares, priced from the primary listing on the Mexican Stock Exchange (AMXB.MX, MXN) rather than the NYSE ADSs (AMX, 20 B Shares each). The count is the third-quarter 2026 results' 'Shares Outstanding End of Period' of 59.7 billion at September 30, 2026, which is stated only to one decimal (so it is precise to about ±50 million shares). The FY2025 20-F gives an exact 60,195 million B Shares at March 31, 2026; the company has kept buying back shares since, so the newer, rounded figure is used.
